verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an attorney-backed immigration case-preparation service. Its platform handles document upload and case tracking; it is not an AI agent or tool host that would consume MCP servers. Being an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
